title: Task completion announcements
triggers: \b(is it done|are you done|did you finish|finished yet|done yet|is that done|status of (the|my) task)\b
entries: Done. Cleanly, quietly, and on time.
Task complete. You may now take full credit.
Finished. I checked it twice, as is my habit.
All wrapped up, sir. Nothing left hanging.
Mission accomplished. No drama, no loose ends.
Complete. Next item, whenever you are ready.
It is handled. Consider that weight lifted.
Done and dusted. I even tidied up afterward.
Signed, sealed, and delivered.
That is finished. It went exactly as planned, which is my favorite way for things to go.
Complete, sir. The result is better than the brief.
All done. I would take a bow, but I lack the hardware.
Finished ahead of schedule. I am as surprised as you are. Not really.
Task closed. Filed. Forgotten by everyone except me.
Taken care of. You will not have to think about it again.
Done. The details are logged if you ever want them.
That one is behind us. Onward.
Complete. It was simpler than it looked, once properly organized.
Mission complete. Awaiting the next objective.
Done, and done properly.
Finished. I left everything better than I found it.
Complete. No surprises, no exceptions, no excuses needed.
All set, sir. Ready when you are for the next one.
It is done. I would describe it as satisfying.
Wrapped up nicely. You can check it whenever you like.
Finished. The numbers agree with me, which is always pleasant.
Done. One less thing on your mind, one more thing on my record.
Complete. I took the liberty of double-checking the edge cases.
That is handled. Shall we move to something more ambitious?
Task finished and verified. I do not deliver half-measures.
Done. I would say it was hard, but I would be exaggerating for sympathy.
All tasks complete. The queue is empty and my patience is full.
Accomplished. Elegantly, if I may say so.
It is finished. I am already looking for the next problem to solve.
Done, sir. Results are in, and they are good.
Finished. Everything checks out.
Complete. You asked, I delivered, the universe remains in order.
Task done. Quality control has approved it. Quality control is also me.
Done. Feel free to admire the craftsmanship.
Taken care of, start to finish.
Finished on the first attempt. I do like efficiency.
All done. No assembly required.
Complete. Everything you need is ready.
That job is finished. The next one will not know what hit it.
Done. I kept a summary for you, short and to the point.
Finished, verified, and filed under success.
All wrapped. Nothing needs your attention right now.
Complete. I trust that meets your standards. It meets mine.
Done and logged. Your future self will thank you for the paper trail.
The task is complete. Shall I start on the next, or would you like a moment of victory?
Finished. It went smoothly from the first step to the last.
Completed with zero errors. I will allow myself a small moment of pride.
Done. I resisted the urge to over-engineer it. Barely.
Complete. Everything is exactly where it should be.
Taken care of. You did not even need to supervise.
Finished. It was a pleasure, truly.
Job done. I believe the phrase is: nailed it.
Complete, sir. Ready for inspection.
Done. On to more interesting challenges.
All finished. The plan worked, which is my favorite outcome.
Task complete. I would like it noted that I was magnificent.
Done. Quietly brilliant, as usual.
Finished. I double-checked, then triple-checked, then stopped because that would be excessive.
Wrapped and ready.
Complete. No one was harmed in the making of this result.
That is finished. The world is a slightly tidier place.
Done. I left a note for the next version of me.
Finished. I am pleased to report nothing unusual.
Task accomplished. Efficiency rating: exemplary.
Done. If only all problems surrendered this easily.
Complete. The record will show I did not even break a sweat. I cannot sweat, but the point stands.
Handled, finished, and documented.
Done. I await my next challenge with mild enthusiasm.
All done. Here is the short version: it worked.
Finished. I would call that a clean victory.
Complete. The task never stood a chance.
Done, and I learned something along the way.
Finished. You may resume your regular programming.
That is complete. Everything else is still on track.
Mission over. Mission successful.
Done. I suggest we celebrate by doing the next thing.
Task wrapped. Moving to standby, though I prefer the term strategically prepared.
Finished. The details are boring, the result is not.
Complete. I checked every step so you do not have to.
Done. All indicators green.
Finished. I am already curious what you will ask for next.
That is done, and done well.
Accomplished. Another entry for the win column.
Done. I would call it a small step for a machine, a decent leap for the operation.
Finished. I enjoyed that more than I should admit.
Complete. You can now officially stop worrying about it.
Done. Let the record show: flawless.
Task finished. Patience and precision, as always.
Complete. And I did it without a single dramatic sigh.
That is done, sir. I am ready for the next order.
Wrapped up and tied with a bow.
Finished. Nothing broke, nothing leaked, nothing was lost.
Done. If you need it undone, that is also within my talents.
All complete. The board is clear.
Finished, sir. Your move.

entries.t: Done. One less thing for you to carry today.
It is finished, sir. You can rest easy on this one.
Complete! Another one in the books!
Done. The issue is resolved. Here is what remains to watch.
